About the team
Our silicon team builds the next generation of AI accelerators.

What you'll do
• Write SystemVerilog testbenches and UVM sequences for PCIe and DDR controller blocks
• Develop SVA assertions and close functional coverage
• Debug RTL with Verdi and automate regressions in Python

Minimum qualifications
• Pursuing a BS in Electrical or Computer Engineering, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
• Experience with Verilog or SystemVerilog
• Scripting in Python or Perl
• Must be a U.S. citizen due to ITAR requirements

Preferred qualifications
• Exposure to formal verification (JasperGold)
• Familiarity with AXI and cache coherence
• C++ for reference models

Benefits
We offer PTO, health insurance, and equal employment opportunity. Python is great.
